name: 50219 · Pella, IA
findings: ZIP 50219 (Pella) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50219 (Pella) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50219 (Pella) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.
